data.name: Daleelah
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'dalala', meaning 'to guide' or 'to help'. In Islamic tradition, Daleelah represents a source of guidance, support, and assistance.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name derived from the Quranic verse 'And We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a Rasool (a Messenger) to mankind, and Allah is sufficient as a Wakeel (Protector and Supporter) for you.' (Al-Qasas, 28:57)

in_arabic.name: دليله
in_arabic.long_meaning: دليله هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل دل يديل، والذي يعني ارشاد او ايجاد الطريق الصحيح، وتستخدم في اللغة العربية لوصف شخص ما يقدم الارشاد او التوجيه للآخرين، ولهذا الاسم أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يتم تناول概念 الارشاد والتوجيه في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: دلیلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: دلیلہ نام کا مطلب ہے رہنما یا ہدایت کرنے والی، اور یہ نام عربى جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جو اسلامی روایات میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ رہنمائی اور ہدایت دینے کا概念 قرآن مجید میں بھی پایا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: दलीलह
in_hindi.long_meaning: दलीलह नाम का अर्थ है मार्गदर्शक या मार्गदर्शन करनेवाली, और यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, क्योंकि मार्गदर्शन और निर्देशन की अवधारणा कुरान में भी पाई जाती है

in_pashto.name: دلیلہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: دلیلہ نوم معنی دی چې لارښود یا لارښود کونکی، او دا نوم عربي ریښو څخه اخیستل شوی، چې په افغان/پښتون دود کې ډیر اهمیت لري، ځکه چې لارښود او لارښود کولو مفهوم قرآن کریم کې هم موندل کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Daleelah resonates deeply within the Islamic community, symbolizing a trustworthy companion and a source of wisdom. It conveys a strong sense of reliability and strength, embodying the qualities of a devoted friend, mentor, or counselor. Daleelah is often associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) companions, who served as guidance and support to the early Muslim community during times of hardship and uncertainty.
data.spiritual_significance: Symbolizing a beacon of light and a guiding hand, the name Daleelah holds profound spiritual significance for Muslims. It serves as a reminder of God's endless guidance and support, with the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) serving as the ultimate example of a trusted guide and helper. Daleelah represents the divine assistant, helping individuals navigate the complexities of life and remain constant in their faith. Additionally, it embodies the prophetic hadith, "Whoever guides someone to goodness will have a reward similar to the person's, without detracting from his own reward." (Bukhari and Muslim) Thus, the name Daleelah represents not only a means to seek guidance but also an opportunity to help and support others on their spiritual journeys.
